description: "The Grain of Dust: A Novel" by David Graham Phillips is a work of fiction written during the early 20th century.
longDescription: The novel introduces its readers to the contrasting lives of two characters: Miss Dorothea Hallowell, an unassuming young woman seeking employment, and Frederick Norman, a young and ambitious lawyer in a prestigious law firm. The narrative explores themes related to social class, ambition, and the complexities of human relationships.

authorInfo.bio: David Graham Phillips (1867–1911) is the author of The Grain of Dust: A Novel. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
